inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL datetime expression converts an epoch-derived value between explicit timezone offsets.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one fixed FROM_UNIXTIME expression and explicit offsets. The view, join, schema, and application data are removed while the expression-result formatting contract remains isolated.

fixture_notes: MariaDB returns a whole-second DATETIME without a fractional suffix for this epoch-derived expression. Before the fix, MySqweel appended .000000 to the same expression result.
determinism_notes: The epoch literal and timezone offsets are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
